m: 1. अप-√ 2. हा Ā. -जिहीते (aor. 3. pl. -अहासत Subj. 1. pl. -हास्महि), to run away from (abl.) or off, RV.
2. अप-√ 3. हा Ā. (aor. Subj. 2. sg. -हास्थाः) to remain behind, fall short, not reach the desired end, AV. xviii, 3, 73 : Pass. -हीयते, to grow less, decrease (in strength, बलम्), Suśr.
a: अपहा — {c2c} P. To leave, abandon; साक्षात्प्रियामुपगतामपहाय पूर्वं Ś. 6. 15. --pass. To waste away, wane.
अपहानं — Leaving, abandoning.

m: अप-हानि f. diminishing, vanishing, Up.
a: अपहानिः — f. 1 Leaving, abandonment; stopping. --2 Ceasing, vanishing. --3 Exception, exclusion.

s: puM, (apa + hf + BAve GaY .) apacayaH । hAniH । ityamaraH ॥ apaharaRaM । cOryyaM । saMgopanaM । DanasvAmyanupayogivyayaH । iti dAyaBAgaH ॥ (vi nASaH । “karRanAsApahAreRa BaginI me virUpitA” । iti rAmAyaRe । steyaM । yadDAnyApahArAdikaM karmma dravyasvAmisamakzaM balAtkftaM tatsAhasaM syAt । iti kallUkaBawwaH । nihRavaH । “kaTaM vA AtmanaH apahAraM karomi” । iti SAkuntale .)
v: pu॰ apa + hf--GaY । 1 cOryye 2 apaharaRe, 3 apanayane । “karRanAsApahAreRa BaginI me virUpiteti” rAmA॰ svAmyanupakAriDanavyaye “nApahAraM striyaH kuryyuH patirikTAt kaTaYcaneti” smftiH । “apahAraSca DanasvAmyanupayoge BavatIti” dAyaBAgaH । 4 apacaye, 5 hAnO, 6 saNgopane ca ।
m: अप-हार m. taking away, stealing
spending another person's property
secreting, concealment, e.g. आत्मापहारं √ 1. कृ, to conceal one's real character, Śāk.
a thief, L.
a shark or a crocodile, L.
a: अपहारः — 1 Taking or carrying away, stealing, plundering, removing, killing, destroying; कर्णनासापहारेण भगिनी मे विरूपिता Rām. by the cutting of ears and nose; निद्रापहार, विष˚. --2 Concealing, dissembling; कथमात्मापहारं करोमि Ś. 1 how shall I dissemble myself, conceal my real name and character; see अपहारक below. --3 Spending or using another's property. --4 Loss, damage.

k.v: अपहारस्त्वपचयः समाहारः समुच्चयः। प्रत्याहार उपादानं विहारस्तु परिक्रमः॥

m: अप-हारण n. causing to take away.

s: tri, (apa + hf + Rvul .) apahArI । apaharaRakarttA । yaTA, -- “parApavAdanirataH paradravyApahArakaH” । iti purARaM ॥ (“dviviDAn taskarAn vidyAt paradravyApahArakAn prakASAMScAprakASAMSca cAracakzurmahIpatiH” ॥ “annaharttAmayAvitvaM mOkyaM vAgapahArakaH । vastrApahArakaH SvEtraM paNgutAmaSvahArakaH” ॥ iti manuH । cOraH । “yo'nyaTA santamAtmAnamanyaTA satsu BAzate । sa pApakfttamoloke svena AtmApahArakaH” । iti manuH .)
v: tri॰ apa + hf--Rvul । 1 cOryyakarttari 2 apasAraRa karttari 3 saNgopaka 4 sTAnAntarApakarzake ca । “jAlApahArakAn pakziRa” iti hito॰ । apahArakaBedASca manunA darSitAH “dviviDAMstaskarAn vidyAt paradravyApahArakAn । prakASAMScAprakASAMSca cAracakzurmahIpatiH । prakASavaYcakAstezAM nAnApaRyopajIvinaH । pracCannavaYcakAstvete ye stenAwavikAdayaH । utkocakAScOpaDikAvaYcakAH kitavAstaTA । maNgalAdeSavfttASca BadrAScEkzaRikEH saha । asamyakkAriRaScEva mahAtrAScikitsakAH । SilpopacArayuktASca nipuRAH paRyayozitaH । evamAdIn vijAnIyAt prakASAMllokakaRwakAn! “nigUQacAriRaScAnyAnanAryyAnAryyaliNgina” iti ।
m: अप-हारक mfn. one who takes away, seizes, steals, &c.
a plunderer, a thief (cf. आत्मापहारक, वाग्-अपहारक.)
a: अपहारक, --हारिन् — a. One who or that which takes away, steals, re moves, destroys, conceals &c. (usually in comp.); जालापहारिणः H. 1; परद्रव्य˚ plunderer, thief; परवित्त˚; वागपहारकः Ms. 11. 51; Y. 3. 210; Ms. 4. 255; 2. 88. --कः A robber, thief.

m: अप-हार—वर्मन् m. N. of a man, Daś.

v: tri॰ apa + hf--Rini striyAM NIp । 1 apaharttari 2 apanAyake ca “indriyARAM vicaratAM vizayezvapahArizu” iti manuH “kzetradArApahArI ca zaqete hyAtatAyina” iti manuH
m: अप-हारिन् mfn. = अप-हारक.
अप-हारित mfn. carried off, R.; Ragh. iii, 50.
अप—˚हार्य mfn. one from whom anything (acc.) is to be taken, Āpast.

s: puM, (apa + has + BAve GaY .) akAraRahAsyaM । iti hemacandraH ॥
m: अप-हास m. id., L.
a mocking laugh, R.
अप-हास्य mfn. to be laughed at, R.
अप-हाय ind. ind.p. quitting, MBh. &c.
leaving, avoiding, Hariv.
leaving out of view, Śāk. &c.
excepting, except, Ragh.
a: अपहाय — ind. Leaving, abandoning, except, without, excepting (used with the force of a preposition).

v: tri॰ apa + hana--“ape kleSatapasoH” pA॰ qa । 1 apaGAtakarttari । kleSApahaH putraH tamo'pahaH sUryyaH । yogaviBAgAdanyatrApi “suparIkzitamannAdyamadyAnmantrErvizApahEriti” manuH
m: अप-ह mfn. ifc. keeping back, repelling, removing, destroying (e.g. शोकापह, q.v.)
a: अपह — a. [अप-हन्-ड] (At the end of comp.) Warding or keeping off, taking away, removing, destroying, repelling &c.; न दंशमशकापहं Pt. 3. 97; स्रगियं यदि जीवितापहा R. 8. 46; परकर्मापहः सोऽभूत् 17. 61.

m: अप-हल mfn. having a bad plough, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 187, Sch.
a: अपहल — a. Having a bad plough.

m: अप-√ हन् (Subj. 3. sg. -हन्; Imper. 2. sg. -जहि, 2. du. -हतम्; 2. pl. -हता, or -हत; perf. -जघान; pr. p. -घ्नत्; Intens. p. nom. m. -जङ्घनत्) to beat off, ward off, repel, destroy, RV. &c.
a: अपहन् — {c2c} P. 1 To ward or beat off, repel, destroy, kill, take away, remove; अपघ्नंतो दुरितं हव्यगंधैः Ś. 4. 7; न तु खलु तयोर्ज्ञाने शक्तिं करोत्यपहंति वा U. 2. 4 takes away; Ms. 6. 96; अपहतपाप्मानं सवितारमुपतिष्ठस्व U. 3. --2 To attack, affect, seize (as disease &c.). --3 To husk out, take off the shell or husk (as rice). --4 To shoot out.

m: अप-हनन n. warding off (cf. अप-घात s.v.)
a: अपहननं — Warding off, repelling &c.

m: अप-हन्तृ mf(त्री, Ragh.)n. beating off, destroying, ŚBr. &c.

v: tri॰ apa + hf--karttari ac । 1 apaharaRakarttari “BadraM BavedBavaBayApaharaM nfloke” iti hemA॰ Bavi॰ pu॰ ।
m: अप-हर &c. See अप-√ हृ.
अप-हर mfn. (ifc.) carrying off, Bhām.

v: tri॰ apaharttumarhati apa + hf--anIyar । 1 apaharaRayogye tAni vastUni ca smftO darSitAni । “dvijo'DvagaH kzIRavfttirdvAvikzU dve ca mUlake । AdadAnaH parakzetrAnna daRqaM dAtumarhati” manuH । “caRakavrIhigoDUma yavAnAM mudgamAzayoH । anizidDErgrahItavyA muzwirekA paTi sTitEriti” “tatrEva saptame Bakte BaktAni zaqanaSnatA । aSvastanaviDAnena hattavyaM hInakarmmaRa iti” ca manuH । “dvijastfREDaHpuzpARi sarvvataH svavadAharediti” yAjYa॰ । “go'gnyarTaM tfRameDAMsi yajYArTe vIrudvanaspatInAM puzpARi svavadAsIta PalAni ceti” gO॰ । 2 apanetavye ca ।
m: अप-हरणीय mfn. to be taken away, carried off, stolen, &c.

v: na॰ apa + hf--lyuw । 1 steye sADAraRasya parakIyasya vA DanAdicOryye । “sItAdravyApaharaRe SastrARAmOzaDasya ceti” “nikzepasyApaharaRaM narASmarajatasya ceti” “BakzyaBojyApaharaRe yAnaSayyAsanasya ca” iti ca manuH steyasvarUpaYca smftO darSitaM yaTA “upAyErviviDErezAM CalayitvApakarzaRam suptamatta pramatteByaH steyamAhurmanIziRa” iti nAra॰ । “syAt sAhasaM tvanvayavat prasaBaM karmmayat kftam । niranvayaM Bavet steyaM kftvApahnUyate ca yaditi” manuH । “anvayavad dravyarakzirAjADyakzAdisamakzaM prasaBaM balAvazwamBena yat paraDanaharaRAdikaM kriyate tat sAhasaM, steyantu tadvilakzaRaM niranvayaM dravyasvAmyAdyasamakza vaYcayitvA yat paraDanaharaRaM taducyate yaccasAnvayamapi kftvA na mayedaM kftamiti BayAt nihnute tadapi steyamiti” mitAkzarA । tacca sADAraRasya parakIyasya vA haraRam “sAmAnyadravyaprasaBaharaRAt sAhasaM smftamiti” yAjYa॰ ukteH । taTAca parakIye sADAraRe vA dravye svatva hetuBUtalOkikakrayapratigrahAdikamantareRa svalampAdanaM haraRam tadeva balapUrvvakaM sAhasamiti Beda iti mitAkzarAdimatam dAyaBAgamate tu sADAraRadravyasya nApaharaRaM paramAtra svatvavaddravyasyEvApaharaRamiti tatrokteriti viSezaH । 2 balAdapakarzaRe ca । “nirviRRo'timamatvena rAjyApaharaRena ceti” devI mA॰ ।
m: अप-हरण n. taking away, carrying off
stealing, Mn.
keeping off all contrarieties, Jātakam.
a: अपहरणं — 1 Taking or carrying away, removing. --2 Stealing.

m: अप-हरस् mfn. not pernicious, PBr.
अप-हर्तृ m. (with gen. [Mn. viii, 190, 192] or acc. [Pāṇ. iii, 2, 135, Sch.] or ifc.) taking away, carrying off, stealing, Mn. &c.
removing (faults), expiating, Mn. xi, 161.
a: अपहर्तृ — a. 1 One that takes or carries away, steals, removes, destroys &c. --2 Removing, expiating; सर्वदोषापहर्तॄणां व्रतानां Ms. 11. 162.

v: tri॰ apa + hf--tfc striyAM NIp । 1 apahArake । “nikzepasyApaharttAra tatsamaM dApayeddamamiti” manuH । tfRi tu naloketyAdinA pA॰ zazWInizeDAt karmaRi dvitIyA ।

m: अप-हर्ष mfn. showing or feeling no joy, Kād.
अप-√ हस् to deride: Caus. -हासयति, to deride, ridicule.
a: अपहस् — {c1c} P. To mock or scoff at, ridicule, deride; साहसापहसितकुमारेण Dk. 9 scoffed at, i. e. excelled.

m: अप-हसित n. silly or causeless laughter, Sāh.
(also) smiling in tears, Daśar.
a: अपहसितं, --हासः — Silly or causeless laughter; often laughter with tearful eyes (नीचानामपहसितं).

v: pu॰ apasAraRArTaH hastaH । 1 galahaste apasAraRAyodyataH hastoyasya । 2 galahastena apasArite tri॰ ।
m: अप-हस्त n. striking or throwing away or off, MBh. iii, 545 [‘the back of the hand’ Comm.]
a: अपहस्तः — [अपसारणार्थो हस्तः] 1 The hand placed on the neck to drive out a person (गलहस्त); one that is so driven out. --2 Throwing away or off, taking away. --3 Stealing, plundering.

m: अप-हस्तक mfn. handless, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
अप-हस्तय Nom. P. ˚यति, to throw away, push aside, repel, (generally used in the perf. Pass. p.)

a: अपहस्तयति — Den. P. To seize by the neck and drive out; hence throw away, abandon, leave, discard, reject (fig. also).

v: tri॰ hastena apasAryate apa + hasta + RickarmaRi kta । 1 galahastAdinA niraste apasArite ।
m: अप-हस्तित mfn. thrown away, repelled, Mālatīm. &c.
a: अपहस्तित — p. p. Thrown away, discarded, abandoned, cast off, given up; ˚सकलसखीजनं त्वयि विश्वसिति मे हृदयं K. 233, 202; ˚बांधवे त्वया Māl. 9. 19; अयं मम ˚लज्जो व्यवसायः V. 2; Ki. 9. 36.

m: अप-हत mfn. destroyed, warded off, killed.
अप-हत—पाप्मन् (अपहत-) mfn. having the evil warded off, free from evil, ŚBr.

v: strI apa + hana--ktin । 1 nASane । “na ha vEsaSarIrasya sataH priyApriyayorapahatirasti” CA॰ u॰ ।
m: अप-हति f. removing, destroying, AitBr. &c.
a: अपहतिः — f. Removing, destroying.

m: अप-हेला f. contempt, L.
अप-हेलन n. = अव-ह्˚, L.
अप-√ हृ to snatch away, carry off, plunder; to remove, throw away: Caus. -हारयति See अप-हारित below.
(also) to captivate, Divyāv.
a: अपहृ — {c1c} P. 1 (a) To take off, bear or snatch away, carry off; पश्चात्पुत्रैरपहृतभरः V. 3. 1 relieved of the burden; तंत्रादचिरापहृतः पटः brought P. V. 2. 70 Sk. (b) To avert, turn away; वदनमपहरंतीं (गौरीं) Ku. 7. 95 averting or turning away her face. (c) To rob, plunder, steal. --2 To sever, separate, cut off; R. 15. 52. --3 To overpower, overcome, subdue; attract, ravish, captivate; affect, influence (in a good or bad sense); अपह्रिये खलु परिश्रमजनितया निद्रया U. 1 overpowered; उत्सवापहृतचेतोभिः Ratn. 1; यथा नापह्रियसे सुखेन K. 109 seduced, led away, 277; न… प्रियतमा यतमानमपाहरत् R. 9. 7 did not subdue i. e. did not divert his mind. --4 To remove, take away, destroy, annihilate, deprive (one) of; कीर्तिं˚ R. 11. 74; प्रिया मे दत्ता वाक् पुनर्मेऽपहृता Dk. 52. --5 To take back, resume; देयं प्रतिश्रुतं चैव दत्त्वा नापहरेत्पुनः Y. 2. 176. --6 To subtract, deduct. --Caus. To cause (others) to take away; Ki. 1. 31.

m: अप-˚हृत् mfn. taking away (comp.), Kāv.
अप-हृत mfn. taken away, carried off, stolen, &c.
a: अपहृत — p. p. Taken away, carried off, &c.; destitute of, free from.

m: अप-हृत—विज्ञान mfn. bereft of sense.
अप-हृति f. carrying off.
अप-√ हि to throw off, disengage or deliver one's self from (acc.), BhP.
अप-हिं-कार mfn. without the syllable हिम् (which is pronounced in singing the Sāma verses), ŚBr.
अपहित mfn. entrusted, L.
charged (with a crime), L.

v: tri॰ apa + hnu--karmmaRi SAnac । 1 apanIyamAne 2 sTAnAntaramapasAryyamARe 3 cOryyamARe ca ।

s: puM, (apa + hnu + BAve ap .) apalApaH । snehaH । iti medinI ॥ (“fRe deye pratijYAte paYcakaM Satamarhati । apahnave taddviguRaM tanmanoranuSAsanam” ॥ iti manuH .)
v: pu॰ apa + hnu--ap । 1 sato'pi vastuno'sattvena kaTanarUpe'palApe, । apahnavaSca dviviGaH SabdataH arTatovA “miTyEtaditi SabdataH, nABijAnAmyahaM, tatra tadA na mama sTitirityevamarTato'pahnava iti । 2 premRi ca ।
m: अप-ह्नव m. concealment, denial of or turning off of the truth
dissimulation, appeasing, satisfying, ŚBr.
affection, love, R.
= अप-ह्नुति, Sāh.
a: अपह्नवः — 1 Concealment, hiding; concealment of one's knowledge, feelings &c. --2 Denial or disowning of the truth, dissimulation; ˚वे ज्ञः P. I. 3. 44; ज्ञातं मया ते हृदयं सखे मापह्नवं कृथाः Ks. 10. 92. --3 Appeasing, satisfying. --4 Love, affection.

m: अप-ह्नवन n. denial, Śīl.
अप-ह्नोतृ mfn. one who conceals or denies or disowns Comm. on Mn. viii, 190.
अप-√ ह्नु Ā. (1. sg. -ह्नुवे) to refuse, RV. i, 138, 4; to conceal, disguise, deny, Kāṭh. &c.; to excuse one's self, give satisfaction to, ŚBr.; TBr.
a: अपह्नु — {c2c} A. 1 To conceal, hide, disguise; Ms. 8. 53; कामदेवव्यपदेशेन सखीपुरतोऽपह्नुतः Ratn. 2 was passed off as Cupid upon her friend. --2 To deny, disown; गुणांश्चापह्नुषेऽस्माकं Bk. 5. 44; अपह्नुवानस्य जनाय यन्निजां (अधीरतां) N. 1. 49. --3 To exculpate, excuse.

v: tri॰ apa + hnu--kta । 1 kftApahAre vastuni yasya cOryyaM kftaM tasmin, 2 sTAnAntaraM nIte, 3 apasArite ca ।
m: अप-ह्नुत mfn. concealed, denied.

s: strI, (apa + hnu + BAve ktin .) apalApaH । apahnavaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ upameyAsatyakaraRapUrvvakopamAnasatyatAvyavasTApikAlaNkftiH । tasyA lakzaRaM । “prakftaM yanniziDyAnyatsADyate sA tvapahnutiH” । udAharaRaM । “avAptaH prAgalByaM pariRatarucaH Selatanaye । kalaNko nEvAyaM vilasati SaSANkasya vapuzi ॥ amuzyeyaM manye vigaladamftasyandiSiSire । ratiSrAntA Sete rajaniramaRI gAQamurasi” ॥ iti kAvyaprakASaH ॥ (“prakftaM pratiziDyAnyasTApanaM syAdapahnutiH । gopanIyaM kamapyarTaM dyotayitvA kaTaYcana ॥ yadi SlezeRAnyaTA vA'nyaTayet sApyapahnutiH” । iti sAhityadarpaRe .)
v: strI apa + hnu--ktin । 1 apahnave “prakftaM pratiziDyAnyasTApanaM syAdapahnutiriti” sA॰ da॰ ukte 2 arTAlaNkAraBede ca । sA ca dviDA apahnavapUrvvakaH anyAropaH, anyAropapUrvvakaH apahnavaSca yaTA “nedaM naBomaRqalamamburASirnEtASca tArA navaPenaBaNgAH । nAyaM SaSI kuRqalitaH PaRIndro nAsO kalaNkaH Sayito murAriH” ॥ “etadviBAti caramAcalacUqacumbi hiRqIrapiRqaruciSItamarIcivimbam । ujjvAlitasya rajanIM madanAnalasya DUmaM daDatprakawalAYCanakEtavena” ॥ “virAjate vyomavapuH payoDistArAmayAstatra ca PenaBaNgAH” । ityAdyAkAreRa prakftanizeDo bodDavyaH । “gopanIyaM kamapyarTaM dyotayitvA kaTaYcana । yadi SlezeRAnyayA vA'nyayayet sApyavahnutiH” sA॰ da॰ tatra SlezeRa yaTA ॥ “kAlevAriGarARAmayatitayA neva Sakyate sTAtum । utkaRWitAsi tarale! na hi na hi saKi! picCilaH patTAH” ॥ atrApatitayetyatra patiM vinetyuktvA patanABAvenetyanyaTAkftam । aSlezeRa yaTA । “iha puro'nilakampitavigrahA milati kA na vanaspatinA latA । smarasi kiM saKi kAntaratotsavaM! na hi GanAgamarItirudAhftA” iti ॥
m: अप-ह्नुति f. ‘denial, concealment of truth’, using a simile in other than its true or obvious application, Kpr.; Sāh.
a: अपह्नुतिः — f. 1 Concealment of knowledge, denial. --2 (In Rhet.) A figure of speech, in which the real character of the thing in question is denied and that of another (alien or imaginary) object is ascribed to, or superimposed upon, it; प्रकृतं यन्निषिध्यान्यत्साध्यते सा त्वपह्नुतिः K. P. 10; (उपमेयमसत्यं कृत्वा उपमानं सत्यतया यत्स्थाप्यते सापह्नुतिः); e. g. नेदं नभोमंडलमंबुराशिर्नैताश्च तारा नवफेनभंगाः . नायं शशी कुंडलितः फणींद्रो नासौ कलंकः शयितो मुरारिः .. see also K. P. 10 and S. D. 683-84.
